_comment: Bundled fallback riddles for BugtongPH. Used ONLY when the connected Notion database is unavailable. Every entry is fixed text committed to this repository — never model-generated at runtime. 'verified' means a human has confirmed the wording and the answer against a source. Entries at confidence 'medium' need that check before this plugin is distributed.

riddles.tagalog: Maliit na bahay, puno ng patay.
riddles.english: A tiny house, packed full of the dead.
riddles.bisaya: Gamay nga balay, puno sa mga patay.

riddles.tagalog: Hindi pari, hindi hari, nagdadamit ng sari-sari.
riddles.english: Not a priest, not a king — yet it wears every kind of thing.
riddles.bisaya: Dili pari, dili hari, nagsul-ob sa nagkalain-laing butang.

riddles.tagalog: Isang balong malalim, punong-puno ng patalim.
riddles.english: One deep well, brimming with blades.
riddles.bisaya: Usa ka lawom nga atabay, puno sa mga sundang.

riddles.english: Here comes Kaka, legs thrown wide open.

riddles.tagalog: Bumili ako ng alipin, mataas pa sa akin.
riddles.english: I bought a slave that stands taller than I do.
riddles.bisaya: Nipalit ako ug ulipon, mas taas pa kay kanako.

riddles.tagalog: Nagtago si Pedro, nakalabas ang ulo.
riddles.english: Pedro went into hiding — with his head left sticking out.
riddles.bisaya: Nagtago si Pedro, nigawas ang ulo.

riddles.tagalog: Isang butil ng palay, sakop ang buong bahay.
riddles.english: One grain of rice, and the whole house is covered.
riddles.bisaya: Usa ka lugas nga humay, natabunan ang tibuok balay.

riddles.english: Not an animal, not a person — and yet it speaks.

riddles.tagalog: Ako'y lumakad, siya'y lumakad; ako'y tumigil, siya'y tumigil.
riddles.english: I walked, it walked; I stopped, it stopped.
riddles.bisaya: Milakaw ako, milakaw siya; mihunong ako, mihunong siya.
